rows.gloss: cloth, woven silk; bandage, fillet turban, diadem
rows.etymology: 7700 paṭṭa² m. 'cloth, woven silk' Kāv., 'bandage, fillet turban, diadem' MBh. [Prob. like paṭa- and *phēṭṭa-¹ from non-Aryan source, of which *patta- in Gy. and *patra- in Sh. may represent aryanization of paṭṭa-. Not < páttra- nor, with P. Tedesco Archaeologica Orientalia in Memoriam Ernst Herzfeld 222, < *pr̥ṣṭa- 'woven', while an assumed borrowing from IA. in Bur. phΛlto-čiṅ 'puttees' is too flimsy a basis for *palta- (~ Eng. fold, &c.) as the source NTS xiii 93]

origin_lemma.gloss: cloth, woven silk; bandage, fillet turban, diadem
origin_lemma.etymology: 7700 paṭṭa² m. 'cloth, woven silk' Kāv., 'bandage, fillet turban, diadem' MBh. [Prob. like paṭa- and *phēṭṭa-¹ from non-Aryan source, of which *patta- in Gy. and *patra- in Sh. may represent aryanization of paṭṭa-. Not < páttra- nor, with P. Tedesco Archaeologica Orientalia in Memoriam Ernst Herzfeld 222, < *pr̥ṣṭa- 'woven', while an assumed borrowing from IA. in Bur. phΛlto-čiṅ 'puttees' is too flimsy a basis for *palta- (~ Eng. fold, &c.) as the source NTS xiii 93]
